Greece reports four Turkish UAVs and one airspace violation on 30 September

30 September 2026 · Northeastern / central / southeastern Aegean · Greek-reported Turkish UAVs

Greek-authority-reported Turkish UAV airspace violations

Greek military reporting reproduced by OnAlert and Veteranos lists four Turkish UAVs, one national-airspace violation and five Athens FIR infringements in the northeastern / central / southeastern Aegean on 30 September 2026. These are different measures within one dated activity record.

Routine identification/interception was reported. Exact flight tracks were not published, and the original GEETHA bulletin was not retrieved directly. The airspace assessment remains attributed to Greece; matching reports do not independently verify it.

Attribution and uncertainty

Origin / operator / attribution
Turkish military attribution and national-airspace assessment are those of Greece, reproduced by OnAlert and Veteranos. The Greek-Turkish airspace dispute remains relevant.
Investigation / uncertainty
Original GEETHA bulletin not retrieved directly. Matching publications corroborate the reported military account, not the flight tracks or disputed airspace assessment. Exact sortie times and locations remain unknown.
